messages:
tess_contingent: Hi folks — I'm converting from contractor to full‑time starting 4/1. Quick logistics: do I need a new I-9 since I filled one as a contractor last year? Also want to update my W-4 withholding and check 401(k) eligibility/start date. Finally, will my contractor badge get swapped to a regular badge or do I need to stop by security?

rebecca_peopleops: Congrats on the conversion, Tess! :tada: Short answers: yes for I-9 (employer must complete a new I-9 for FT hires), you can submit a new W-4 via Workday, and 401(k) eligibility depends on your role but usually enrolls on your first day as FT (you'll get an invite). Badge: security needs to swap profiles at the desk.

aria_payroll: Hi Tess — once HR sets your FT hire date (4/1), Workday will open benefits and payroll changes. For W-4: go to Workday > Pay > Tax Withholding and submit before your first pay run if you want changes reflected immediately. 401(k): look for an email from Fidelity — elections typically take effect the first payroll after enrollment.

hr_bot: Background check check: previous contractor BG (ref BG-1102) expired (completed 13 months ago). Policy requires a fresh pre‑hire BG for FT conversions older than 12 months. Please complete consent form; People Ops will re-run.

tess_contingent: Okay — how do I complete the new I-9? Can I reuse the contractor I-9 documents or do I need originals? I'm remote but plan to be in-office 4/1.

rebecca_peopleops: For the FT I-9 we need a Section 2 verifier to physically inspect originals. Since you'll be in-office on 4/1, bring your passport or DL+SSN card to reception and we'll do the verifier check then. If your plans change, we can route an authorized agent.

marc_it: FWIW your contractor laptop will be re-imaged for FT provisioning. Drop your machine at IT bench after orientation and we'll swap the profile — you won't lose data if you back up to your Redwood OneDrive first. If you want a fresh device, let me know this week and I'll check inventory.

badge_bot: Temporary badge note: existing contractor badge will be deactivated at 11:59pm on 3/31 as part of offboarding. Bring photo ID on 4/1 for new FT badge issuance at Security. If you need floor-level access before 9am, request pre-provisioning from People Ops.

rebecca_peopleops: Checklist for Tess (copy/paste):
```
- Upload signed FT offer ack to Workday (if not already)
- Complete and submit BG consent form (People Ops will re-run BG)
- Bring originals for I-9 Section 2 on 4/1 (passport OR DL + SSN card)
- Submit W-4 in Workday before first payroll if withholding change desired
- Watch for Fidelity 401(k) invite after HR confirms FT start
- Leave contractor laptop at IT bench after orientation for re-imaging OR request replacement
- Return contractor badge at Security; new FT badge issued after I-9 verification
```

rebecca_peopleops: I'll DM you the BG consent link and schedule a 10am I-9 slot on 4/1. Any conflicts, tell me and we'll adjust.

tess_contingent: Perfect, thanks all — please DM the BG link. I'll also back up my laptop tonight and confirm whether I want a replacement device by EOD Friday.

aria_payroll: One more payroll note: because there's a payroll cutoff on the 25th, if your hire paperwork isn't in by 3/24 your first paycheck might land on the next cycle. We'll monitor and ping you if anything hits that cutoff.

hr_bot: Reminder queued: send "FT conversion checklist + benefits invite" to tess_contingent at 08:00 on 3/30.

rebecca_peopleops: Welcome aboard officially — excited to have you fully on the team, Tess! :sparkles:
